answer: One slot can't cover both friends from JST — 8am your time is a comfortable 3pm in Pacific but nearly midnight in the UK — so I'd run two short daily check-ins inside the windows you gave me: 8:00–8:15am JST with your Pacific friend (3:00pm their previous day) and 9:00–9:15pm JST with your UK friend (12:00pm their time). On weekends, since you're not free until 9, just slide the morning one to 9:30–9:45am JST (4:30pm Pacific) and keep the evening one at 9:00pm. Just remember these drift by an hour when US/UK daylight saving kicks in, since Japan doesn't observe it — the UK check-in would land at 1:00pm their time in summer.
